_comment: copy to mcp_servers.json and keep only what you want. every tool from every server here becomes a ro capability, approval-gated. secrets are keychain refs, never values. thousands more servers exist — any mcp server slots in the same way.

filesystem._adds: read/write a folder you choose (notes, projects)

github._adds: issues, prs, repos, code search across all of github

brave-search._adds: web search for the research agent

puppeteer._adds: a second, scriptable browser besides ro's built-in one

google-maps._adds: places, directions, travel times for planning

slack._adds: read channels, post messages (gated) in your workspace

postgres-readonly._adds: ask questions of any database you point it at

sqlite._adds: query local sqlite files (exports, app data)
